preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each ancestor b[i] must be a valid vertex number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain n distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(w) <= 10**9 for w in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output n weights, each between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(dist[p[i]] < dist[p[i+1]] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The distances from the root to the vertices in the permutation must be strictly increasing.
